params.message:
Leave the owner out of who carries or takes over

The owner hands the knowledge over, so offering them as a co-carrier or as
the one who takes it over makes no sense. The colleague chips in the panel
now skip whoever matches the configured owner name (the name alone or
followed by a surname). The owner stays in the Medewerkers group and in
the CSV.
